title.narrative: Lifesaving Cash Assistance and Livestock Support for Drought-Affected Communities in Baidoa Rural - LIDAC

description.narrative: ltpgtIRS has an operational presence in southwest, delivering integrated humanitarian assistance in line with the HNRP and cluster priorities. IRS works in close coordination with federal, state, and district authorities, community leaders, and humanitarian partners, enabling principled, needs-based, and accountable responses to drought, displacement, and protection risks.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtIn alignment with HNRP Strategic Objectives 1 and 2, IRS proposes a lifesaving cash-based intervention targeting the most vulnerable drought-affected households in Baidoa Rural. The project provides lifesaving emergency Unconditional Cash Transfers (UCT) to 1721HHs and a Cash Plus (Cash+) package combining UCT with emergency livestock inputs to 1,030HHs, benefiting 16,506 individuals. The intervention directly contributes to reducing food insecurity, protecting livelihoods, and preventing negative coping mechanisms, including those linked to gender-based violence and child protection risks. At least 60% of beneficiaries are women, and 15% are PwD, and marginalized groups, in line with HNRP commitments to inclusion and protection mainstreaming.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project prioritizes drought-affected households facing livestock losses, water and fodder shortages, income gaps, displacement, and protection risks, including GBV and social exclusion. It ensures equitable inclusion of women-headed households, pregnant and lactating women, PwD, the elderly, minority and marginalized groups, IDPs, and households with orphans. Targeted communities include Bula Jaay (265), Reebey (311), Arragaduud (313), Baadi Cade (275), Gooyale (310), Lafaale (356), Boonkey (305), Qeyrcade (290), and Awdiinle (326).lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtBeneficiary selection follows Vulnerability-Based Targeting (VBT), consistent with HNRP and Food Security Cluster guidance. Community-elected committees lead identification and verification through transparent and inclusive processes supported by intensive community awareness on eligibility criteria, cash modalities, and entitlements. Protection and PSEA Focal Points oversee targeting to mitigate exclusion, exploitation, and harm. Accountability to Affected Populations is ensured through multiple, accessible CFM, including toll-free hotlines, suggestion boxes, help desks, and direct reporting channels. Communication uses local languages and diverse formats, including posters, loudspeakers, one-to-one engagement, pre-recorded messages, and visual aids, ensuring access for persons with disabilities, illiterate community members, and other vulnerable groups.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtCash assistance is provided in three transfers through an unconditional Cash Plus approach, combining cash and emergency livestock inputs to protect livelihoods and strengthen resilience, aligned with HNRP’s integrated, multisectoral priorities. Beneficiaries are registered and verified through Islamic Relief Somalia’s Electronic Beneficiary Management System (EBMS) using biometric fingerprint validation, in line with HCT guidance to prevent duplication. Transfers are delivered via secure mobile money platforms through a trusted financial service provider.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtMonitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning are integrated throughout implementation, including post-distribution monitoring and participatory evaluations to assess intervention and protection outcomes and inform adaptive management. Protection, safeguarding, conflict sensitivity, and Do No Harm principles are mainstreamed across all activities in line with HNRP protection centrality commitments.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtIRS supports HNRP coordination and leadership structures, manages three CCCM catchments in Baidoa, and actively participates in the Food Security, WASH, Protection, and CCCM clusters. IRS is an active member of the PSEA Network and the Community Engagement and Accountability Task Force, supporting ABC mechanisms to ensure coordinated, non-duplicative assistance. Project staff and selected community representatives receive PSEA and GBV training led by the PSEA Focal Point.ltbrgtlt/pgt
